messages.subject: Possible bug in ggsave
parts:
Hi, I was trying to save a plot with a table inside (produced with ggExtra::geom_table, see the code below) and the table shows up empty if the file is a bitmap (I tried with png,bmp, and jpg) but it shows up correctly if saved as pdf. I don't know if this is a bug in ggplot2, ggExtra or some device.

Cheers

#Set up plot, got it from another mail on the list
p = qplot(1:2, 1:2) + theme_bw()

d <- data.frame(my.values = c( "x=12", "y=1.34"))

p + annotate("table", x=1.2, y=1.5, table=d, just=c("left", "top"),
            theme=theme.list(show.box = TRUE, separator = "black",
              show.csep = TRUE, show.rsep = TRUE, show.colnames=T))

#Don't Work
ggsave("test.jpg")
ggsave("test.png")
ggsave("test.bmp")

#Works
ggsave("test.pdf")

parts:
Hi,

The problem doesn't seem related to ggplot2 at all,

library(gridExtra)
png()
grid.table(head(iris), theme=theme.list(show.box = TRUE, separator = "black",

dev.off()

It can be one of several things:

- a misuse of transparency in the theme

- a bug in tableGrob

- a bug in Grid

- a bug in some devices

I'll try to find time to investigate this later.

Best,

baptiste

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Possible bug in ggsave
parts:
OK, I nailed it down,

library(grid)

foo <- function(){
grid.rect(gp=gpar(fill="black"))
print(get.gpar()$fill)
grid.rect(width=0.2,height=0.2)
}

png("test.png", bg = "transparent")
foo()
dev.off()

png("test1.png", bg = "white")
foo()
dev.off()

basically the default fill colour for Grid objects depends on the
device (who knew that ?!). It resulted in a white rectangle being
plotted over the table when the setting show.box was set to TRUE, on
most devices. I have sent an email to query about this behavior to
R-devel, and I also corrected grid.table() setting the box fill to NA
in all cases.

Best,

baptiste
